source_note: 正式联调库 demo-v1.1（成员 1 交付，2026-01 ~ 2026-09，页面管线与 expected.json 逐分一致）

clarify_round1.question: 你说的「销售额」是指哪一个指标？

options.label: 净销售额
options.definition: 所选期间实付金额减去同期成功退款金额

options.label: 实付金额
options.definition: 所选期间成功支付订单的实付金额之和，不做退款扣减

clarify_round2.definition: 所选期间实付金额减去同期成功退款金额
clarify_round2.sql:
WITH paid AS (
  SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) AS paid_amount
  FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.pay_status = 'success' AND o.pay_time >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND o.pay_time <= '2026-09-30 23:59:59'
), refund_pre AS (
  SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
       JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE r.refund_status = 'success' AND r.refund_time >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND r.refund_time <= '2026-09-30 23:59:59'
  GROUP BY r.order_id
), refund AS (
  SELECT SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM refund_pre
)
SELECT COALESCE(p.paid_amount, 0) AS paid_amount, COALESCE(q.refund_amount, 0) AS refund_amount, COALESCE(p.paid_amount, 0) - COALESCE(q.refund_amount, 0) AS net_sales
FROM paid p FULL OUTER JOIN refund q ON 1=1;

causal.suggestion: 现有数据只能反映结果指标的变化，缺少活动、价格、竞品等外部变量，无法判断下降原因。可以改为查询「华东地区各月净销售额」观察变化幅度。
